metadata.title: Drafting an Offer Isn't Just the Letter.
metadata.purpose: Answer one real question in the Plain register: when Claude 'drafts an offer,' is that just the congratulatory letter, or something else? Lands the carry-out that the draft is the total comp package, the letter itself, and negotiation guidance for the hiring manager.
metadata.anchor_pair: N/A — source is skill-teardown format (anatomy -> pipeline -> constraint -> verdict), no anchor structure to preserve

beats.narration_text: Someone assumes drafting an offer means writing the congratulatory letter. It's more than that — it's the full comp package: base, equity, signing bonus, the letter, and guidance for the hiring manager.

shot.new_visual_element: Writer types 'Can Claude just write the offer letter for a hire?', hesitates on 'letter', corrects to 'package'

beats.note: B00 is Remotion (BrutalistHesitantWriter) per hai-simple SKILL.md WRITER LAW. TIMING LAW: 20-35 word narration + lead_silence_s 0.8 to give the typing a >=9s window; verify media/B00.mp4 >= 8s and that the correction ('letter' -> 'package') is visible on a late frame.

beats.act: 1 anatomy — a skill is a folder
beats.narration_text: This kind of drafting is built from something called a skill — a folder Claude reads before it works. Inside is one file, written in plain language, that spells out exactly what counts as a finished offer. Claude reads the file, then follows it. The file is the whole program.

shot.new_visual_element: A folder icon opening to reveal SKILL.md, references/, scripts/; SKILL.md highlighted

production_viz.label: A skill is a folder
production_viz.mechanic: A folder opens on cream to reveal three items: SKILL.md (highlighted in crimson), a references/ folder, a scripts/ folder. A caption below reads 'Claude reads it, then follows it.'

beats.narration_text: The steps run in order: read the file, work through each step exactly as written, then return the result. Nothing runs out of sequence unless a step itself says so.

shot.new_visual_element: Three-phase pipeline: Read SKILL.md -> Execute steps in order -> Return result

production_viz.label: Input in, output out
production_viz.mechanic: Three cards left to right joined by arrows: 'Read SKILL.md', 'Execute steps in order', 'Return result'. Linear, no branch points drawn.

beats.narration_text: For this skill, there are exactly three things it covers once a candidate is ready for an offer: assembling the total comp package — base, equity, signing bonus; writing the offer letter text itself; and prepping negotiation guidance for the hiring manager. Ask it about anything else and there's no mode that covers it.

shot.new_visual_element: Three mode cards: comp package, offer letter, negotiation guidance; a boundary line with 'nothing outside this list' beyond it

production_viz.label: Exactly three parts
production_viz.mechanic: Three rows fill in one at a time with a checkmark: 'Comp package — base, equity, signing bonus', 'Offer letter — the text itself', 'Negotiation guidance — for the hiring manager'. A dashed boundary line beneath the list, with a faint unlabelled field beyond it captioned 'nothing outside this list'.

beats.narration_text: Drafting an offer here isn't just the congratulatory letter — it's the full comp package, the letter itself, and negotiation guidance for the hiring manager, once a candidate's ready to hire.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Here's the prompt — read it with me. Ask Claude: I'm hiring a software engineer at a hundred forty thousand dollar base. Help me draft a complete offer — the total comp package with base, equity, and signing bonus, the offer letter text itself, and negotiation talking points for the hiring manager. Liam, in for Bear.
